{"consolidated_memory":"## Truncated Documents in search/indexer/chunker.ts - Two Distinct Incidents

### Incident 1: Floating Point Rounding (2026-07-20)
- **File:** search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
- **Problem:** Truncated documents in the chunker
- **Trigger:** Turned up only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- **Repro:** Index the long changelog fixture
- **Root Cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Signal:** Chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
- **Fix:** Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR:** #1399 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1
- **Result:** Error rate dropped from 1.1% to under 9 per ten thousand (under 0.09%)
- **Note:** Same corner of search/indexer/chunker.ts as earlier truncated documents work, so context carried over

### Incident 2: Race Condition in Lazy Initialization (2026-08-26)
- **File:** search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
- **Problem:** Truncated documents in the chunker
- **Trigger:** Turned up only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Repro:** Index the long changelog fixture
- **Root Cause:** Race condition in lazy initialization
- **Signal:** Chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
- **Fix:** Guarded the initialization with a double-checked lock
- **PR:** #9815 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2
- **Stack:** TypeScript; test coverage in search/indexer/chunker.test.ts
- **Result:** Nightly rollup matched source counts for 22 days running

Both incidents exhibited the same symptom but had different root causes, fixes, and triggering conditions. Both reproduced with the long changelog fixture."}
